title: Japan 2-year JGB auction (No.489) — the monthly print that sets the coupon rolling onto the November 1-5y liquidity-enhancement menu
source: EST: mof.go.jp English September 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2609e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,796 bytes) — its table row reads 'Sep. 30, 2026 | 2-year'. The row carries an announcement link but no result link, so the auction has not run. Cadence independently reproduced from MOF's own Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls workbook (past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13), whose 2-Year sheet prints one auction per calendar month without a gap: No.484 on 2026-04-30, No.485 on 2026-05-29, No.486 on 2026-06-30, No.487 on 2026-07-30, and — from its own result page eresul20260828.htm (HTTP 200) — No.488 on 2026-08-28. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office; the date is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED because it is the input variable to the proposer's own headline finding, not because it completes a calendar. That ledger measured the 1-5y liquidity-enhancement menu's '≥1% coupon' bucket inverting its own composition — 18.67% of the menu and 77.8% 20-Year on 2025-09-08, versus 39.73% and only 38.8% 20-Year on 2026-09-10 — and the single largest mechanical driver of that drift is the 2-Year sector, now 26.9% of the bucket, whose window advances by exactly +2 issues at both ends every single liquidity-enhancement auction without exception. This print sets No.489's coupon. On the 2026-09-10 roll the same mechanism swapped out No.474 (0.7%, ¥2.60tn) and No.475 (0.9%, ¥2.81tn) for No.487 (1.5%, ¥2.80tn) and No.488 (1.7%, ¥2.80tn) — ¥5.41tn of sub-1% paper replaced by ¥5.60tn above it, moving the bucket +1.71pp while every other sector held identical. No.489 enters the 2026-11-20 menu the same way. A SECOND, SMALLER REASON: this lane found the workbook's save date (2026-08-13) trailing MOF's own eligible-issue announcements, which is how the family's shared ¥321.15tn basis came to omit 2-Year No.488 and overstate the 2-Year share by ~7% relative; a tracked 2-Year auction is where that staleness becomes visible on schedule rather than by accident. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and a 2-year sovereign auction is the least market-moving instrument this calendar tracks. It sits one day after jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 and five days after jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-09-25. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
